crossRefs.note: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him…
He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know…
Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, “Follow me.” And he…
Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.”
When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow…
He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.
But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours…
that no flesh should boast before God.
For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast…

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
translations.bsb: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
translations.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
translations.asv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee; what then shall we have?
